definitions.gloss: noble; virtuous; having high moral integrity
definitions.explanation: Describes a person of high moral character who is upright, pure in conduct, and free from corruption. A literary and somewhat formal word.

examples.japanese: {高潔|こうけつ}な⟦{人柄|ひとがら}→人柄：08163_hitogara⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
{高潔|こうけつ}な⟦{精神|せいしん}→精神：03377_seishin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}ち→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。

⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{権力|けんりょく}→権力：10020_kenryoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{誘惑|ゆうわく}→誘惑：14209_yuuwaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{屈|くっ}せ→屈する：09142_kussuru⟧ず、{高潔|こうけつ}な⟦{生|い}き{方|かた}→生き方：10014_ikikata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貫|つらぬ}いた→貫く：18728_tsuranuku⟧。
examples.english: He resisted the temptation of power and lived a life of integrity.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{高|こう}→高〜：03951_kou⟧ (high) and {潔|けつ} (clean/pure). Describes moral elevation and purity of character. This is a literary, somewhat formal word used to praise someone's unwavering moral standards.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高潔|こうけつ}な⟦{人物|じんぶつ}→人物：03356_jinbutsu⟧: a person of integrity
- {高潔|こうけつ}な⟦{精神|せいしん}→精神：03377_seishin⟧: noble spirit
- {高潔|こうけつ}な⟦{人格|じんかく}→人格：11427_jinkaku⟧: noble character/personality
- {高潔|こうけつ}さ: nobility, virtuousness

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{清廉|せいれん}→清廉：20342_seiren⟧: upright / incorruptible — focuses on being free from corruption, especially in public office
- ⟦{高尚|こうしょう}→高尚：14761_koushou⟧: lofty / refined — emphasizes refined tastes or elevated thinking, not necessarily moral purity
- ⟦{潔白|けっぱく}→潔白：17952_keppaku⟧: innocent / blameless — focuses on being free from guilt or wrongdoing
- ⟦{品格|ひんかく}→品格：09179_hinkaku⟧: dignity / grace — broader term for having refined character
